entries.what: Labor Day: college closed. Rochelle packs a cooler and takes Andre, Aaliyah and DeShawn to the Delgado Park picnic, keeping her back happy with a folding chair.
entries.outcome: Easy family day, no studying until evening.

entries.what: Andre works the holiday at Ridgeline for time-and-a-half, so he joins the park late, still in his yard boots.
entries.outcome: Extra pay noted on the fridge calendar.

entries.what: After dinner she does Sunday-style batch cooking a day late and reviews index cards at the kitchen table.
entries.outcome: Week's meals ready, cards done through the heart.

entries.what: Back to Tamsen Valley: she parks the van in Lot C by 8:15 and eats her cooler lunch in the car between Chemistry sessions.
entries.outcome: Got a spot and made class on time.

entries.what: Intro Chemistry at 11 a.m. is moles-heavy; she asks questions loudly when others stay quiet.
entries.outcome: Understood the problem set by the end.

entries.what: Tuesday clash: she skips Pedro's 4 p.m. study group to drive Loretta to the pharmacy at 3:30.
entries.outcome: Loretta's prescriptions picked up, study group missed.

entries.what: Keisha calls on her dispatch break about the weekend and nags her about studying.
entries.outcome: Quick call, plan to borrow the pickup if the van acts up.

entries.what: Anatomy at 9 a.m. with Dr. Okoye, sitting next to Linh, then Wednesday lab.
entries.outcome: Filled four pages of notes.

entries.what: At the kitchen table that night she works out how to repay Keisha the $300 textbook loan in small bits without showing up on the joint account.
entries.outcome: Settles on cash payments from tiny amounts she sets aside.

entries.what: Laundry with her old hospital drama on while Andre sleeps early.
entries.outcome: Folded two baskets.

entries.what: She meets Denny Wu, who maps her four-semester prerequisite sequence ending spring 2027.
entries.outcome: Leaves with a printed plan she calls Denny's map.

entries.what: Chemistry class at 11 and a walk on the Ulloa marsh boardwalk for her back afterward.
entries.outcome: Back loosened up.

entries.what: Evening at Ruiz Family Market for meat and fretting over the book budget.
entries.outcome: Stayed under the grocery limit.

entries.what: Morning anatomy; she hears the first online quiz opens next week and worries about her browser freezing mid-quiz, asking what happens if it does.
entries.outcome: Decides to take it at the library, not on her phone.

entries.what: Gets gas-station coffee with two creamers before running errands for Andre's boots.
entries.outcome: Errands done.

entries.what: Egrets home opener: she and DeShawn go to the Flats High stadium with Andre dozing off after an early shift.
entries.outcome: Home by 10, a fun night.

entries.what: Saturday: laundry, house cleaning and a call from Luisa's voice notes about warehouse gossip.
entries.outcome: Learned about overtime rumors at RF-4.

entries.what: She studies cards at the library for two hours then stands to rest her back.
entries.outcome: Covered the nervous system.

entries.what: Family dinner at home with Aaliyah teasing her about index cards.
entries.outcome: Aaliyah borrows the cards anyway.

entries.what: Skips Sunday service to batch cook red beans and rice.
entries.outcome: Week's food done.

entries.what: Andre watches football and falls asleep by the second half while she preps the wall calendar for next week.
entries.outcome: Calendar colored in.

entries.what: Late evening at the kitchen table reviewing cards for Monday's anatomy.
entries.outcome: Ready for the week.
